title: Document, report and workflow authority
summary: NotNotes owns document definitions, document/revision state, references, reports and workflow feasibility. Renderers and Help Desk are consumers of semantic projections, not replacement business engines.
invariants: Documents and relationships remain authoritative NotNotes objects with version/revision identity.
Semantic application and document projections supply renderer-neutral meaning.
The Initech Help Desk and Wire UI renderers do not invent or change NotNotes workflow state.
A saved report added at runtime must be discoverable by consumers without a new hard-coded command.
Historic consumer tests do not establish that omitted package sources are qualified in the current repository.
procedure: Fetch the versioned live NotNotes semantic application projection from the actual installed class.
Fetch document projections to determine actions and feasibility using the business model.
Keep source version and provider provenance in outputs and qualification records.
Requalify on the real ooRexx interpreter after restoring immutable platform source.

provenance.claim: Published consumer documentation describes MiniNotesApp.semanticApplicationProjection and semanticDocumentProjection.
Published source import explicitly omits the accepted delivery ZIP's vendored dependency closure.
